metadata.scenario: A student calls to get information about upcoming workshops and classes offered by the community center. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, this is Harold Gonzalez. I wanted to inquire about upcoming workshops and classes at the community center. I’m sorry, Harold, but we don’t actually offer workshops or classes here. We focus on home healthcare services. Oh, I see. I must have called the wrong number, then. No problem at all! If you’re looking for information about your care, I can definitely assist with that. Actually, I have some questions regarding the nursing services for my COPD and cardiac monitoring. Sure! We provide skilled nursing care that includes frequent vital sign checks. How can I help you with that? I just want to ensure my wife can be present during all the visits. Absolutely, we can accommodate that request. Your wife can be present for all visits. That’s great to hear. When can I expect the next visit? Let me check your last visit. It was one week ago, so we can schedule a visit for early next week. Could we do it on Monday? Yes, Monday works. We can send a nurse in the morning. Does that work for you? Yes, that’s perfect. Can you ensure it’s a Spanish-speaking nurse? Of course! I’ll make a note to arrange for a Spanish-speaking caregiver. Thank you. I appreciate that. Is there anything else you’d like to discuss while I have you on the line? I was wondering about the costs for the skilled nursing visits. Our skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125 for a 1-2 hour visit. That’s understandable. Is insurance accepted? Yes, we accept many insurance plans, and I can help with the insurance authorization as well. That would be helpful, thank you. Great! I’ll have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, reach out to you about the insurance details. Perfect, I look forward to that. Just to confirm, we have you scheduled for Monday with a Spanish-speaking nurse. Yes, that’s correct. Thank you for your help! You’re welcome! If you have any further questions, feel free to call us anytime. Thanks again! Goodbye. Goodbye, Harold! Take care.
